title: .sl/pending/<readback_id>.json
description: A readback waiting for the owner's answer, written by sl readback: numbered items, each an approve target with its rendered text and the content hash it had when it was read back.

readback_id.description: rb_ and at least four digits, the next free number. Equals the file name.

created_at.description: When the readback was rendered, as an ISO timestamp.

target.description: The approve target: source.model, source.model.field, metric:<name> or access, or golden:<name>, a golden sl goldens confirm records.

kind.description: What the owner is asked: approve the item.

text.description: The readback as rendered for the owner.

content_hash.description: The target's content hash when it was read back, the value sl approve records as approved_hash; for a golden, the hash of the golden with the rows and tolerance read back.

tolerance.description: golden:<name> items only: the tolerance read back, which sl goldens confirm records when it is not given --tolerance.

evidence.description: Measure and metric items only: the figure on today's data and the rows behind it, or why it is not shown. Evidence only: it is outside content_hash and never holds a protected value.

figure.description: The total (a large integer as a string; null when no row counts).

row_count.description: A measure's rows: the rows its filter keeps.

parts.description: A metric's measures, each with its own total and rows.

not_shown.description: Why the figure is not shown, in one line.
